creator: admin
title: What you are looking at
text:
One wiki, two sites:

|!Site |!Address |!Who |!What it does |
|Public |https://wiki.theophile.dev |anyone |read the wiki, no login, served from the cache |
|Admin |https://admin.wiki.theophile.dev |the owner |edit the wiki, behind Cloudflare Access |

Every change the owner saves goes to storage at once, and the public site shows it within seconds: the exact pages that changed are cleared from Cloudflare's cache.

The admin address is not a secret. Anyone can open it and gets a login page, and no further. That login is the only lock, and it never reaches the wiki's code.
